name: Describe Job
description: Describes one job of this Platform: which path the run took through its workflow's steps, where it is or stopped, and what it said. platform-describe reads the job's record and the stored workflow as the read-only service account and lays the run over the guide's steps; the job publishes the description and shows it on a Work Center card. Reads only; a job that is not there ends the job with the reason (ADR 0080 decision 6)
